Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. Kardian's leadership are keen to move forward with a private deployment (on-prem + VPC hybrid) for our clinical inference workloads. Before we run this through procurement we need a clear commercial that separates: licensing (per-node vs seat), the platform fee (one-time vs amortized), and the support tiers (hours, response times).

Three asks from procurement:
- A modular quote for 12/24/36 month terms that shows platform fee amortization and monthly ops costs.
- A proposal for support tiers and included hours (Standard / Business / Premium).
- Any options to reduce upfront impact (credits, implementation retainer vs platform credit).

We expect initial deployment to be 4 NVIDIA H100 nodes (in their private cloud) with potential burst to 8 for peak inference windows. ETA for procurement review: end of May.

Appreciate any draft you can share.

Best,

Evan — thanks, and great to hear Kardian is readying procurement. Attaching a pricing matrix and a short SOW draft to start (private_stack_pricing_matrix.xlsx, Kardian_SOW_v2.pdf).

High-level options (summary):
- License model A: Per-node annual license + platform fee (one-time). Platform fee can be amortized over 12/24/36 months — we show all three lines in the attached matrix.
- License model B: Per-node monthly meter + smaller platform fee. Better if you want operational op-ex smoothing.
- Support tiers (examples):
  • Standard — 8x5 email support, 48hr P1 response, 10 included hours/month.
  • Business — 24x7 email + pager, 8hr P1 response, 30 included hours/month, on-call rotation during rollout.
  • Premium — 24x7 dedicated SME on-call, 2hr P1 response, 100 included hours/month, quarterly on-site health checks.

Quick asks so we size the proposal correctly:
- Confirm whether "burst to 8" is transient (events) vs sustained.
- Any regulatory constraints for on-site staff or SOC2 evidence needed for contract?

As an initial commercial posture, we generally show a 15–20% discount on list for 24-month committed deployments (higher with prepaid commits) and offer implementation credits (equivalent to 1–2 months platform fee) if a 36-month term is accepted.

Ben — can you review the SOW & pricing assumptions and flag any unusual delivery risk?
Marissa — I'll leave commercial counter-proposals to you; procurement timeline is end of May.

Thanks,

Vanessa / Marissa — procurement reviewed your matrix. A few clarifying asks and redlines we need before moving to legal:
1) Can you provide a commercial with a 6-month platform fee credit (i.e., waive platform fee for first 6 months) instead of a retainer? Procurement prefers a lower upfront capital impact.
2) We need licensing expressed as a per-node, per-month rate with a minimum committed node count (4 nodes) and an optional burst allowance (up to 8 nodes). If Kardian spikes above burst for >30 days, we pay the per-node rate retroactively.
3) Support: please cap total included hours per month and provide an overage hourly rate. Also define SLAs in the quote (response times, escalations).
4) We need the platform fee and SOW deliverables explicitly carved out in a DocuSign-ready addendum — procurement will not sign a blended PDF.
5) Any possibility to include a 3% annual price escalator for node licensing instead of fixed list price increases?

Final note: procurement is amenable to a commercial trade — if Redwood accepts the 6-month platform fee credit and the 3% escalator, we can commit to a 24-month contract with a prepay option for year 1. Please respond with a revised commercial; legal will want the DocuSign addendum.

Regards,
Lloyd (on behalf of Kardian Procurement)

Folks — forwarding Lloyd's asks with recommended counter below. If we agree, Vanessa should send the revised commercial (with matrix and DocuSign stub) to Lloyd.

Ben's recommended counter (internal):
- Offer the 6-month platform fee credit but convert it to an implementation milestone credit: for each accepted milestone (kickoff, runbook complete, production handoff) we apply a credit that nets to ~6 months of platform fee. That keeps finance happy (ties credits to deliverables).
- Per-node per-month rate: convert Marissa's annual $78k to $7,000 / node / month (example) with a minimum 4 node commitment. Burst up to 8 nodes with a 30-day retroactive billing trigger if sustained >30 days.
- Support: Business tier — 30 included hours / month, overage billed at $250/hr. Provide explicit SLAs in the support addendum.
- Price escalator: accept a 3% annual escalator, but cap escalator to 3% or CPI whichever is lower.
- Prepay incentive: 3% additional discount for year-1 prepay; 2% for full 24-month prepay.

Ask Vanessa / Marissa: can you produce a revised matrix that: (a) shows the implementation-credit approach, (b) includes the DocuSign-friendly addendum links, and (c) converts to the per-node monthly rows Lloyd requested? I'll own the legal-side language for the escalator and billing triggers.

Thanks,
